title: Laminar flow in a 90° square-duct bend, Re 790
headline: peak velocity at the measured position at six stations; peak U/V_c converging (GCI ≤ 0.05 %)

toolchain.conversion: gmshToFoam, with -keepOrientation when the worst scaled Jacobian is positive (task 0108)

gates.quantity: matched inlet (a plug 12.6 $D_h$ upstream, the length fitted to the X_H = −0.50 profile alone): peak $U/V_c$ on the symmetry plane at θ = 60° and 77.5°, k = 1, 2, 3
matched inlet, finest level: the peak's gapwise position on the symmetry plane at every station from X_H = −0.25 on (its outward shift through the bend)
reported, not gated: X_H = −0.50 (the calibration station); $U/V_c$ RMS difference per station (5 % comparison, floor: the upstream mismatch); the rig inlet (plug at 7.5 $D_h$) as a sensitivity run
